article.title: The UAW needs a strategy for the future of manufacturing
article.author: Editor
article.content: For the UAW and the entire working class, it will be impossible to reverse the decline of the labor movement, let alone go on offense, through piecemeal reforms or tinkering with organizing tactics. The post The UAW needs a strategy for the future of manufacturing appeared first on MR Online .
